615	/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/
616	
617	/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (§43). -/
618	def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
619	  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
620	    match s.A[j]? with
621	    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
622	    | none => none
623	
624	/-- Cases 2–4 of §43 for an active authority of own mode `m` covering the leaf, whose covering
625	active descendants have modes `ds`. -/
626	def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
627	  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe
628	
629	/-- `effective(s, a, l)` (§43, cases 1–4), computed per leaf. -/
630	def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
631	  match s.A[a]? with
632	  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
633	  | none => none
634	
635	/-- Compatible effective modes for independent ordinary accesses: only `Observe`/`Observe`
636	(§50). -/
637	def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe
638	
639	/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded (§43). -/
640	def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False
641	
642	/-- Decidability of `Allows` (§43). -/
643	instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
644	  unfold Allows; infer_instance
645	
646	/-- Footprint of authority `a` (§42), empty if it does not exist. -/
647	def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
648	  | some x => x.footprint
649	  | none => []
650	
651	/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
652	def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }
653	
654	/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/
655	
656	/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
657	the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
658	effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
659	holder cycle justifies a right. -/
660	inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
661	  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
662	      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
663	  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
664	      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
665	      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
666	
667	/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
668	def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
669	  match s.A[a]? with
670	  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
671	    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
672	    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
673	        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
674	  | none => false
675	
676	/-- `any` depends only on the values of the predicate on the list (decision procedure for
677	§43). -/
678	theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
679	    l.any f = l.any g
680	  | [], _ => rfl
681	  | a :: l, h => by
682	    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
683	      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]
684	
685	/-- `exR` is a bounded monotone rule (decision procedure for §43). -/
686	theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
687	  mono p q hpq a h := by
688	    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
689	    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
690	      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
691	      · simpa using h.2
692	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
693	        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
694	        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
695	    · exact h
696	  bound p a h := by
697	    unfold exR at h; split at h
698	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
699	    · cases h
700	  loc p q hpq a := by
701	    unfold exR; split
702	    · congr 1; split
703	      · rfl
704	      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
705	    · rfl
706	
707	/-- Soundness of the iteration for `ExercisableAt` (decision procedure for §43). -/
708	theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
709	    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
710	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
711	  | k + 1, a, h => by
712	    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
713	    split at h
714	    · rename_i y hy
715	      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
716	      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
717	      split at h
718	      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
719	      · rename_i p hp
720	        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
721	        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
722	        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
723	    · cases h
724	
725	/-- The frame-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
726	theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
727	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
728	    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
729	  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]
730	
731	/-- The place-held case of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
732	theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
733	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
734	    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
735	    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
736	  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
737	    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
738	  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩
739	
740	/-- `ExercisableAt` is computed by `|A| + 1` steps of `exR` (decision procedure for §43). -/
741	theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
742	    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
743	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
744	  induction h with
745	  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
746	  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
747	    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
748	    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
749	    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih
750	
751	/-- Decidability of `ExercisableAt` (§43). -/
752	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
753	  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm
754	
755	/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
756	effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
757	def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
758	  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
759	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m
760	
761	/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
762	instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
763	  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

766	
767	/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (§44: dependencies of contained values
768	are accounted for transitively). -/
769	def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
770	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D
771	
772	/-- The anchors of every place containing leaf `p` are valid, that is, active (§44; §66.3,
773	§67.3, §68.3). -/
774	def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
775	  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
776

778	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=

780	
781	/-- The frame of the effective anchor of `x` (the frame of its holder) exists and is `fd` or an
782	ancestor of `fd` (§44). -/
783	def EffAnchorOK (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=
784	  OptP (s.A[s.effAnchor x]?) (fun z => OptP (s.hframe z.holder)
785	    (fun g => OptP fd (fun f => ancestor s.F g f) False) False) False
786	
787	/-- Decidability of `EffAnchorOK` (§44). -/
788	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Decidable (EffAnchorOK s x fd) := by
789	  unfold EffAnchorOK; infer_instance
790	
791	/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44, §54): for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, the frame of the
792	effective anchor of `x` is the frame of `q` or an ancestor. -/
793	def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
794	
795	/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P` (decision procedure for §44). -/
796	theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
797	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
798	  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩
799	
800	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrder` (§44). -/
801	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrder s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrder_iff.symm
802	
803	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44, §54): the rule of `AnchorOrder` for every active authority held by a
804	usable place `q`. -/
805	def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
806	  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
807	    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
808	
809	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A` (decision procedure for
810	§44). -/
811	theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
812	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
813	      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
814	        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
815	  constructor
816	  · intro h q _ hq x _
817	    unfold OptP; split
818	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
819	    · trivial
820	  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
821	    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
822	    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh
823	
824	/-- Decidability of `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44). -/
825	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm
826

828	
829	/-- `Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail` (§58). `fail` leaves the state unchanged and
830	carries none. -/
831	inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
832	  | ok (s : σ)
833	  | reject
834	  | fail

836	/-- A kernel transition other than `alloc` (§58): `ok` with the effect when the preconditions
837	hold, `reject` otherwise; never `fail`. -/
838	inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
839	  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
840	  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic

/-!
# Access kernel: operations O1–O16

The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` §60–§75. Each
operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
  active : s.Active a
  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
Invariants.lean:172:inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
Invariants.lean:173:  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
Invariants.lean:174:  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'
Ops.lean:10:`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
Ops.lean:911:inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
Ops.lean:963:inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops
2	
3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability
5	
6	`WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53), `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` (§57), the declared
7	statics and `S3.init` (§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics`
8	under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
9	`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
10	-/
11	
12	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
13	
14	/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/
15	
16	/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
17	def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none
18	
19	/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
20	instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
21	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
22	
23	/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
24	authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
25	def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
26	  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
27	    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
28	      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r
29	
30	/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
31	`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
32	place. -/
33	def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
34	  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
35	    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
36	    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r
37	
38	/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
39	origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
40	def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
41	  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
42	    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner
43	
44	/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/
45	
46	/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
47	acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
48	structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
49	  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
50	  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
51	  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
52	  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
53	  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
54	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
55	  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
56	  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
57	  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
58	      f < s.nF) ∧
59	    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
60	      o < s.P.length) ∧
61	    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
62	  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
63	  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
64	    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
65	  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
66	  root authority. -/
67	  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
68	  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
69	  rootChain : RootChain s
70	  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
71	  rootHeld : RootHeld s
72	  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
73	  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
74	    HolderLive s y.holder
75	
76	/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/
77	
78	/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
79	both have own mode `Observe`. -/
80	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
81	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
82	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
83	    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe
84	
85	/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
86	origin's and the derived footprint is within the origin's. -/
87	def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
88	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
89	    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint
90	
91	/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
92	def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
93	
94	/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
95	def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
96	  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls
97	
98	/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
99	def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s
100	
101	/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
102	def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
103	  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
104	    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint
105	
106	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
107	def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s
108	
109	/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/
110	
111	/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
112	place holding `b`. -/
113	def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
114	  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
115	    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
116	    | .frame _ => False) False
117	
118	/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
119	def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
120	  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
121	  | _ => True
122	
123	/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
124	authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
125	whole place holding the next. -/
126	def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
127	  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
128	    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
129	      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
130	      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)
131	
132	/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/
133	
134	/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
135	initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
136	abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)
137	
138	/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47; not stated by §47, a hypothesis of the theorems on the
139	initial state): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's
140	owning static. -/
141	def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))
142	
143	/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
144	instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
145	  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance
146	
147	/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
148	another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
149	leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead or
150	pinned. -/
151	def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
152	  { F := [0]
153	    nF := 1
154	    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
155	    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
156	    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
157	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
158	        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
159	    D := fun _ => []
160	    dead := fun _ => false
161	    pin := fun _ => false }
162	
163	/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
164	directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
165	def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
166	  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →

19: theorem chainF_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) :

24: /-- Any fuel at least the start index gives the same chain (§40, §42; acyclicity, §49). -/
25: theorem chainF_fuel (org : Nat → Option Nat) :
26:     ∀ k₁ k₂ i, i ≤ k₁ → i ≤ k₂ → chainF org k₁ i = chainF org k₂ i
27:   | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
28:   | 0, _ + 1, i, h, _ => by
29:     obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
30:     simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
31:   | _ + 1, 0, i, _, h => by
32:     obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
33:     simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
34:   | k₁ + 1, k₂ + 1, i, h₁, h₂ => by
35:     simp only [chainF]; split
36:     · split
37:       · rw [chainF_fuel org k₁ k₂ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
38:       · rfl
39:     · rfl

53: theorem chainF_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i j, j ∈ chainF org k i → j < i
54:   | 0, _, _, h => by simp [chainF] at h
55:   | k + 1, i, j, h => by
56:     simp only [chainF] at h; split at h
57:     · split at h
58:       · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
59:         · assumption
60:         · exact Nat.lt_trans (chainF_lt k _ j h) ‹_›
61:       · simp at h
62:     · simp at h

70:   | 0, _ => by simp [chainF]
71:   | k + 1, i => by
72:     simp only [chainF]; split
73:     · split
74:       · simp only [List.length_cons]; have := chainF_length (org := org) k ‹_›; omega
75:       · simp
76:     · simp

85:   | 0, _, _ => rfl
86:   | k + 1, i, h => by
87:     simp only [chainF]; rw [h i (Nat.le_refl i)]; split
88:     · split
89:       · rw [chainF_congr k _ fun j hj => h j (by omega)]
90:       · rfl
91:     · rfl

100:     r' ∈ chainF org k i → org r' = none → r = r'
101:   | 0, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp [chainF] at h
102:   | k + 1, i, r, r', h, hr, h', hr' => by
103:     simp only [chainF] at h h'; split at h
104:     · rename_i o ho; simp only [ho] at h'
105:       split at h
106:       · rename_i hlt; simp only [hlt, ↓reduceIte] at h'
107:         rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 h' with rfl | h'
108:         · rfl
109:         · rw [chainF_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
110:         · rw [chainF_none hr'] at h; simp at h
111:         · exact chainF_root k _ r r' h hr h' hr'
112:       · simp at h
113:     · simp at h

115: /-- A chain contains the chain of each of its elements, for links to smaller indices (§40, §42,

117: theorem chain_trans {org : Nat → Option Nat} (hlt : ∀ i o, org i = some o → o < i) :
118:     ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ r, r ∈ chain org i → ∀ o ∈ chain org r, o ∈ chain org i
119:   | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
120:   | n + 1, i, hi, r, hr, o, ho => by
121:     cases hp : org i with
122:     | none => rw [chain_none hp] at hr; simp at hr
123:     | some p =>
124:       have hpi := hlt i p hp
125:       rw [chain_cons hp hpi] at hr ⊢
126:       rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr with rfl | hr
127:       · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ho
128:       · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (chain_trans hlt n p (by omega) r hr o ho)

theorem effective_addAuth_notin {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {a p : Nat} (ha : a < s.A.length)

/-- Under `I1`, an authority derived from `src` with a mode permitted on leaf `p`, and an active
authority covering `p` outside the origin chain of the new one, are both `Observe` (§50, §60.3). -/
theorem new_vs_old {s : S3} (ht : I1 s) {src b p : Nat} {x y : Authority} {m : Mode}
    (hx : s.A[src]? = some x) (xa : x.active = true) (xp : p ∈ x.footprint)
    (hal : Allows (effective s src p) m) (hy : s.A[b]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true)
    (yp : p ∈ y.footprint) (hbs : b ≠ src) (hbn : b ∉ s.ancs src) :
    m = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe := by

  by_cases hsb : src ∈ s.ancs b
  · have hm : y.mode ∈ descModes s src p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, yp, hsb, rfl⟩

    · simp [h0] at hm
    · exact ⟨rfl, mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)⟩
  · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := ht src b x y p (Ne.symm hbs) hx hy xa ya xp yp hsb hbn

/-- `split` adds its authorities one region at a time (§61, `ok` effect). -/
theorem splitEff_cons (s : S3) (src : Nat) (r : List Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) :
    splitEff s src (r :: rs) =
      splitEff (s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩) src rs := by
  simp [splitEff, S3.addAuth, S3.top]

/-! ## Same authorities up to holders (§42, §63) -/

/-- Skeleton of an authority (§42): every field but its holder. -/
def skel (z : Authority) : Mode × Option Nat × List Nat × Bool :=
  (z.mode, z.origin, z.footprint, z.active)

/-- `s'` has the authorities of `s` up to their holders (§42; §63: a transfer creates and
duplicates no authority). -/
def SameSkel (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  s'.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ j : Nat, (s'.A[j]?).map skel = (s.A[j]?).map skel

/-- An authority of `s'` has a counterpart in `s` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.get {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hj : s'.A[j]? = some y') : ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
  | some y => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y, rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩

/-- An authority of `s` has a counterpart in `s'` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.get' {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hj : s.A[j]? = some y) : ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
  cases hy : s'.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
  | some y' => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y', rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩

/-- Same skeletons give the same origin links (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.org {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.org = s.org := by
  funext j
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none =>
    cases hy' : s'.A[j]? with
    | none => simp [S3.org, hy, hy']
    | some y' => obtain ⟨y, h1, -⟩ := h.get hy'; rw [hy] at h1; cases h1
  | some y => obtain ⟨y', hy', e⟩ := h.get' hy; simp [skel] at e; simp [S3.org, hy, hy', e.2.1]

/-- Same skeletons give the same origin chains (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.ancs {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.ancs = s.ancs := by
  funext j; simp [S3.ancs, h.org]

/-- Same skeletons give the same active authorities (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.active {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {x : Nat} :
    s'.Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩; obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := h.get hy'
    exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [skel] at he; rw [← he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩; obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    exact ⟨y', hy', by simp [skel] at he; rw [he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩

/-- Same skeletons give the same covering descendants (§43). -/
theorem SameSkel.descModes {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
    descModes s' a p = descModes s a p := by
  unfold Access.descModes; rw [h.1, h.ancs]
  refine filterMap_congr' fun j _ => ?_
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => have := h.2 j; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[j]? <;> simp_all
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

/-- Same skeletons give the same effective modes (§43). -/
theorem SameSkel.effective {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
    effective s' a p = effective s a p := by
  unfold Access.effective; rw [h.descModes]
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => have := h.2 a; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[a]? <;> simp_all
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

/-- `I1` depends only on the skeletons (§50). -/
theorem SameSkel.i1 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h1 : I1 s) : I1 s' := by
  intro a b x' y' p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
  obtain ⟨x, hx, ex⟩ := h.get ha; obtain ⟨y, hy, ey⟩ := h.get hb
  simp [skel] at ex ey; rw [h.ancs] at hnab hnba
  rw [ex.1, ey.1]
  exact h1 a b x y p hab hx hy (ex.2.2.2 ▸ xa) (ey.2.2.2 ▸ ya) (ex.2.2.1 ▸ xp) (ey.2.2.1 ▸ yp)
    hnab hnba

/-- `I2` depends only on the skeletons (§51). -/
theorem SameSkel.i2 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h2 : I2 s) : I2 s' := by
  intro b y a hb ho
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hm, hh⟩ := h2 b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)
  obtain ⟨x', hx', e'⟩ := h.get' hx₀; simp [skel] at e'
  exact ⟨x', hx', by rw [e.1, e'.1]; exact hm,
    fun p hp => by rw [e'.2.2.1]; exact hh p (e.2.2.1 ▸ hp)⟩

/-- The origin clause of `WF3` depends only on the skeletons (§49.5). -/
theorem SameSkel.origins {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s')
    (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) :
    ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s'.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b := by
  intro b y a hb ho
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
  exact hw b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)

/-- A property of every footprint member depends only on the skeletons (§49.4). -/
theorem SameSkel.footprints {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {Q : Nat → Prop}
    (hw : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l) :
    ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s'.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l := by
  intro a x hx l hl
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, e⟩ := h.get hx; simp [skel] at e
  exact hw a x₀ hx₀ l (e.2.2.1 ▸ hl)

/-! ## `release` (§62) -/

/-- Element `j` after setting element `a` (§62, §65 effects). -/
theorem set_get {l : List Authority} {a j : Nat} {x' : Authority} (ha : a < l.length) :
    (l.set a x')[j]? = if a = j then some x' else l[j]? := by
  rw [List.getElem?_set]; split <;> simp_all

/-- The effect of `release` on an existing authority (§62, `ok` effect). -/
theorem releaseEff_eq {s : S3} {a : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) :
    releaseEff s a = { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q } := by
  simp [releaseEff, hx]

/-- The anchors after a release: those before, without `a` at the place holding it (§62, `ok`
effect). -/
theorem release_D_mem {s : S3} {a q y : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
    (hy : y ∈ (releaseEff s a).D q) : y ∈ s.D q ∧ (y = a → x.holder ≠ .place q) := by
  rw [releaseEff_eq hx] at hy; simp only at hy
  split at hy
  · rename_i hh
    obtain ⟨hy, hne⟩ := List.mem_filter.1 hy
    exact ⟨hy, fun e => by subst e; simp at hne⟩
  · exact ⟨hy, fun _ => ‹_›⟩

/-- A release keeps the origin links (§62). -/
theorem release_org {s : S3} {a : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) :
    (releaseEff s a).org = s.org := by
  funext j; rw [releaseEff_eq hx]
  simp only [S3.org, set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx)]
  split
  · subst_vars; simp [hx]
  · rfl

/-- A release keeps the origin chains (§62). -/
theorem release_ancs {s : S3} {a : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x) :
    (releaseEff s a).ancs = s.ancs := by
  funext j; simp only [S3.ancs, release_org hx]

/-! ## Consequences of `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- A part has the owner of every place it belongs to (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem WF3.ownerOf_aux {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n l r, l < n → partOf s.P l r →
      ∃ pl pr, s.P[l]? = some pl ∧ s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ pl.owner = pr.owner
  | 0, _, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, l, r, hl, ⟨hlen, hlr⟩ => by
/-- A part has the death marker of every place it belongs to (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem WF3.deadOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {l r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P l r) :
    s.dead l = s.dead r :=
  hw.deadOf_aux (l + 1) l r (Nat.lt_succ_self l) h

/-- A structural parent exists and precedes its child (§49.2). -/
theorem WF3.parent_lt {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {i o : Nat} (h : parentOf s.P i = some o) :
    o < i ∧ o < s.P.length := by
  simp only [parentOf] at h
  cases hp : s.P[i]? with
  | none => rw [hp] at h; cases h
  | some pl =>
    rw [hp] at h
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, -⟩ := hw.places i pl o hp h
    exact ⟨hlt, lt_of_getElem? hpr⟩

/-- The current frame of a nonempty stack belongs to it (§39, §49.1). -/
theorem top_mem {s : S3} (h : s.F ≠ []) : s.top ∈ s.F := by
  unfold S3.top; cases hF : s.F with
  | nil => exact absurd hF h
  | cons f F => simp

/-! ## Usability (§40) -/

/-- Usability depends only on places, stack and death markers: a smaller stack and more dead
places give fewer usable places (§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.mono {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : ∀ f ∈ s'.F, f ∈ s.F)
    (hd : ∀ q, s'.dead q = false → s.dead q = false) {q : Nat} (h : s'.Usable q) :
    s.Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | frame hpl hdq ho hf => exact .frame (by rw [← hP]; exact hpl) (hd _ hdq) ho (hF _ hf)
  | place hpl hdq ho _ ih => exact .place (by rw [← hP]; exact hpl) (hd _ hdq) ho ih

/-- Usability depends only on places, stack and death markers (§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    {q : Nat} : s'.Usable q ↔ s.Usable q :=
  ⟨S3.Usable.mono hP (fun f h => hF ▸ h) (fun q h => hd ▸ h),
   S3.Usable.mono hP.symm (fun f h => hF ▸ h) (fun q h => by rw [hd]; exact h)⟩

/-- Usability carries over between states with the same places, stack and death markers
(§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.of_eqs {s s' : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s'.Usable q) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : s.Usable q :=
  S3.Usable.mono hP (fun _ h => hF ▸ h) (fun _ h => hd ▸ h) h

/-- Liveness of a holder depends only on places, stack and death markers (§49.8). -/
theorem HolderLive.congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (h : Holder) : HolderLive s' h ↔ HolderLive s h := by
  cases h with
  | frame f => simp [HolderLive, hF]
  | place p => exact S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd

/-- A place with the owner and the death marker of a usable place is usable (§40). -/
theorem S3.Usable.of_same {s : S3} {q r : Nat} {pl pr : Place} (h : s.Usable q)
    (hq : s.P[q]? = some pl) (hr : s.P[r]? = some pr) (ho : pr.owner = pl.owner)
    (hd : s.dead r = s.dead q) : s.Usable r := by
  cases h with
  | frame hpl hdq hof hf =>
    rw [hq] at hpl; cases hpl; exact .frame hr (by rw [hd]; exact hdq) (by rw [ho]; exact hof) hf
  | place hpl hdq hof hu =>
    rw [hq] at hpl; cases hpl; exact .place hr (by rw [hd]; exact hdq) (by rw [ho]; exact hof) hu

/-- A part of a usable place is usable (§40: parts share owner and death marker; §49.2). -/
theorem usable_of_partOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n r q, r < n → partOf s.P r q → s.Usable q → s.Usable r
  | 0, _, _, h, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, r, q, hr, ⟨hlen, hrq⟩, hu => by
    rcases hrq with rfl | hc
    · exact hu
    cases hpo : parentOf s.P r with
    | none => rw [chain_none hpo] at hc; simp at hc
    | some p =>
      obtain ⟨pl, hpl, hpar⟩ : ∃ pl, s.P[r]? = some pl ∧ pl.parent = some p := by
        simp only [parentOf] at hpo
        cases h' : s.P[r]? with
        | none => rw [h'] at hpo; cases hpo
        | some pl => rw [h'] at hpo; exact ⟨pl, rfl, hpo⟩
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, hd⟩ := hw.places r pl p hpl hpar
      rw [chain_cons hpo hlt] at hc
      have hup : s.Usable p := by
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hc with rfl | hc
        · exact hu
        · exact usable_of_partOf hw n p q (by omega) ⟨lt_of_getElem? hpr, .inr hc⟩ hu
      exact hup.of_same hpr hpl ho.symm hd.symm

/-- The place containing a usable part is usable (§40: parts share owner and death marker;
§49.2). -/
theorem usable_of_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {l r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P l r)
    (hu : s.Usable l) : s.Usable r := by
  obtain ⟨pl, pr, hpl, hpr, ho⟩ := hw.ownerOf h
  exact hu.of_same hpl hpr ho.symm (hw.deadOf h).symm

/-! ## Root places (§40, §49.6, §49.7) -/

/-- A place belongs to at most one root place (§40). -/
theorem rootOf_unique {P : List Place} {l r r' : Nat} (hr : RootPlace P r)
    (hr' : RootPlace P r') (h : partOf P l r) (h' : partOf P l r') : r = r' := by
  obtain ⟨-, hr⟩ := hr; obtain ⟨-, hr'⟩ := hr'
  obtain ⟨-, h | h⟩ := h <;> obtain ⟨-, h' | h'⟩ := h'
  · exact h.symm.trans h'
  · subst h; rw [chain_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
  · subst h'; rw [chain_none hr'] at h; simp at h
  · exact chainF_root _ _ _ _ h hr h' hr'

/-- Every place of a well-formed state is a part of a root place (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem exists_rootPlace {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) : ∀ n q, q < n → q < s.P.length →
    ∃ r, RootPlace s.P r ∧ partOf s.P q r
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hqn, hq => by
    cases hp : parentOf s.P q with
    | none => exact ⟨q, ⟨hq, hp⟩, hq, .inl rfl⟩
    | some o =>
      obtain ⟨hlt, hol⟩ := hw.parent_lt hp
      obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hor⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw n o (by omega) hol
      refine ⟨r, hr, hq, .inr ?_⟩
      rw [chain_cons hp hlt]
      rcases hor with rfl | hor
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hor

/-- The footprint of a part is within the footprint of the whole (§40, §49.2). -/
theorem footprint_sub {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {q r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P q r) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s.P q) : l ∈ footprint s.P r := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  refine mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hqr⟩ := h
  rcases hlq with rfl | hlq
  · exact hqr
  · rcases hqr with rfl | hqr
    · exact .inr hlq
    · exact .inr (chain_trans (fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1) (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) q
        hlq r hqr)

/-- A decidable property failing somewhere below `n` has a witness below `n` (§40, search for a
leaf). -/
theorem exists_lt_not_of_not_forall {p : Nat → Prop} [DecidablePred p] :
    ∀ n, ¬ (∀ r < n, p r) → ∃ r < n, ¬ p r
  | 0, h => absurd (fun r hr => absurd hr (Nat.not_lt_zero r)) h
  | n + 1, h => by
    by_cases hn : p n
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := exists_lt_not_of_not_forall n fun h' => h fun r hr => by
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hr with hr | rfl
        · exact h' r hr
        · exact hn
      exact ⟨r, by omega, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n, hn⟩

/-- Every place of a well-formed state has a leaf in its footprint (§40, §49.2: parts follow
their parent, so the search for a part without part terminates). -/
theorem exists_mem_footprint {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n q, s.P.length - q < n → q < s.P.length → ∃ l, l ∈ footprint s.P q
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hn, hq => by
    by_cases hleaf : isLeaf s.P q
    · exact ⟨q, mem_footprint.2 ⟨hq, hleaf, hq, .inl rfl⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := exists_lt_not_of_not_forall _ hleaf
      have hpr : parentOf s.P r = some q := Decidable.of_not_not hpr
      have hlt : ∀ i o, parentOf s.P i = some o → o < i := fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1
      have hqr := hlt r q hpr
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw n r (by omega) hr
      obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf', -, hlr⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
      refine ⟨l, mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf', hlP, .inr ?_⟩⟩
      have hrq : q ∈ chain (parentOf s.P) r := by
        rw [chain_cons hpr hqr]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      rcases hlr with rfl | hlr
      · exact hrq
      · exact chain_trans hlt (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) r hlr q hrq

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7) carries over to a state with the same places and no more usable places,
which keeps every active root authority of `s` unchanged. -/
theorem RootHeld.transport {s s' : S3} (h : RootHeld s) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hU : ∀ r, s'.Usable r → s.Usable r)
    (hA : ∀ (i : Nat) (z : Authority), s.A[i]? = some z → z.active = true → z.origin = none →
      s'.A[i]? = some z) : RootHeld s' := by
  intro r hr hu
  rw [hP] at hr
  obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, zm, hpr, hh, hf⟩ := h r hr (hU r hu)
  exact ⟨i, z, pr, hA i z hz za zo, za, zo, zm, by rw [hP]; exact hpr, hh, by rw [hP]; exact hf⟩

/-- `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7) carries over to a state with the same places whose root
authorities are root authorities of `s` with the same footprint and holder. -/
theorem RootHeldConv.transport {s s' : S3} (h : RootHeldConv s) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hA : ∀ (x : Nat) (z' : Authority), s'.A[x]? = some z' → z'.origin = none →
      ∃ z, s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z'.footprint = z.footprint ∧
        z'.holder = z.holder) : RootHeldConv s' := by
  intro x z' l r hx ho hl hr hlr
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzo, hf, hh⟩ := hA x z' hx ho
  rw [hP] at hr hlr
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hpr'⟩ := h x z l r hz hzo (hf ▸ hl) hr hlr
  exact ⟨pr, by rw [hP]; exact hpr, hh.trans hpr'⟩

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6) carries over to a state with the same tree of places, the same origin
chains, the same footprints, and the same root authorities. -/
theorem RootChain.transport {s s' : S3} (h : RootChain s) (hlen : s'.P.length = s.P.length)
    (hpar : parentOf s'.P = parentOf s.P) (hanc : ∀ a, s'.ancs a = s.ancs a)
    (hA : ∀ (a : Nat) (y' : Authority), s'.A[a]? = some y' →
      ∃ y, s.A[a]? = some y ∧ y'.footprint = y.footprint)
    (hroot : ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none →
      ∃ z', s'.A[x]? = some z' ∧ z'.origin = none ∧ z'.footprint = z.footprint) :
    RootChain s' := by
  intro a y' l ha hl hleaf
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hf⟩ := hA a y' ha
  have hleaf0 : isLeaf s.P l := by simpa only [isLeaf, hlen, hpar] using hleaf
  obtain ⟨x, z, r, hx, hz, hzo, hr, hlr, hfz⟩ := h a y l hy (hf ▸ hl) hleaf0
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hz'o, hz'f⟩ := hroot x z hz hzo
  refine ⟨x, z', r, by rw [hanc]; exact hx, hz', hz'o, ?_, ?_, fun l' => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [RootPlace, hlen, hpar] using hr
  · simpa only [partOf, hlen, hpar] using hlr
  · rw [hz'f, footprint_congr hlen hpar]; exact hfz l'

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6) depends only on the skeletons and the tree of places. -/
theorem SameSkel.rootChain {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (hc : RootChain s)
    (hlen : s'.P.length = s.P.length) (hpar : parentOf s'.P = parentOf s.P) : RootChain s' :=
  hc.transport hlen hpar (fun a => by rw [h.ancs])
    (fun a y' ha => by obtain ⟨y, hy, e⟩ := h.get ha; simp [skel] at e; exact ⟨y, hy, e.2.2.1⟩)
    (fun x z hz hzo => by
      obtain ⟨z', hz', e⟩ := h.get' hz; simp [skel] at e
      exact ⟨z', hz', e.2.1.trans hzo, e.2.2.1⟩)

/-! ## Additions of authorities and `WF3` (§49, §50, §51, §60, §61) -/

/-- An addition keeps the places (§42). -/
theorem addAuth_P (s : S3) (y : Authority) : (s.addAuth y).P = s.P := rfl
/-- An addition keeps the stack (§42). -/
theorem addAuth_F (s : S3) (y : Authority) : (s.addAuth y).F = s.F := rfl
/-- An addition keeps the death markers (§42). -/
theorem addAuth_dead (s : S3) (y : Authority) : (s.addAuth y).dead = s.dead := rfl

/-- Adding an authority derived from `src`, within its footprint, preserves `RootChain`
(§49.6). -/
theorem rootChain_addAuth {s : S3} (h : RootChain s) {src : Nat} {x y₀ : Authority}
    (hx : s.A[src]? = some x) (ho : y₀.origin = some src)
    (hfp : ∀ p ∈ y₀.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) : RootChain (s.addAuth y₀) := by
  have hs := lt_of_getElem? hx
  intro a y l ha hl hleaf
  rcases addAuth_get ha with ⟨ha', ha''⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨x0, z, r, hx0, hz, rest⟩ := h a y l ha'' hl hleaf
    have hx0lt : x0 < s.A.length := by
      rcases hx0 with rfl | hx0
      · exact ha'
      · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hx0) ha'
    exact ⟨x0, z, r, by rw [ancs_addAuth_lt ha']; exact hx0, by rw [addAuth_lt hx0lt]; exact hz,
      rest⟩
  · obtain ⟨x0, z, r, hx0, hz, rest⟩ := h src x l hx (hfp l hl) hleaf
    have hx0lt : x0 < s.A.length := by
      rcases hx0 with rfl | hx0
      · exact hs
      · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hx0) hs
    refine ⟨x0, z, r, .inr ?_, by rw [addAuth_lt hx0lt]; exact hz, rest⟩
    rw [ancs_addAuth_self ho hs]
    rcases hx0 with rfl | hx0
    · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx0

/-- Adding an active authority derived from `src` whose mode is permitted by the effective mode
of `src` on each leaf of its footprint preserves `I1` (§50, §60.2, §60.3). -/
theorem addAuth_I1 {s : S3} (ht : I1 s) {src : Nat} {x : Authority} {m : Mode} {fp : List Nat}
    {hd : Holder} (hx : s.A[src]? = some x) (hal : ∀ p ∈ fp, Allows (effective s src p) m) :
    I1 (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) := by
  have hs := lt_of_getElem? hx
  have hxp : ∀ p ∈ fp, x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint := fun p hp => by
    have := hal p hp; unfold Allows OptP at this; split at this
    · rename_i e he
      obtain ⟨x', hx', xa', xp', -⟩ := effective_some he
      rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'; exact ⟨xa', xp'⟩
    · exact this.elim
  intro a b x' y' p hab ha hb xa' ya' xp yp hnab hnba
  rcases addAuth_get ha with ⟨ha', ha''⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ <;>
    rcases addAuth_get hb with ⟨hb', hb''⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · rw [ancs_addAuth_lt hb'] at hnab; rw [ancs_addAuth_lt ha'] at hnba
    exact ht a b x' y' p hab ha'' hb'' xa' ya' xp yp hnab hnba
  · rw [ancs_addAuth_self rfl hs] at hnab
    exact (new_vs_old ht hx (hxp p yp).1 (hxp p yp).2 (hal p yp) ha'' xa' xp
      (fun e => hnab (e ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)) fun e => hnab (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ e)).symm
  · rw [ancs_addAuth_self rfl hs] at hnba
    exact new_vs_old ht hx (hxp p xp).1 (hxp p xp).2 (hal p xp) hb'' ya' yp
      (fun e => hnba (e ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)) fun e => hnba (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ e)
  · exact absurd rfl hab

/-- Adding an active authority derived from `src`, with a mode not above the mode of `src`, a
footprint within the footprint of `src`, a mode permitted by the effective mode of `src` on each
leaf, and a live holder, preserves `WF3` (§49) and `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53). Shared by `derive` (§60)
and `split` (§61). -/
theorem addAuth_preserves {s : S3} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s) {src : Nat} {x : Authority}
    {m : Mode} {fp : List Nat} {hd : Holder} (hx : s.A[src]? = some x) (hm : m.le x.mode)
    (hfp : ∀ p ∈ fp, p ∈ x.footprint) (hal : ∀ p ∈ fp, Allows (effective s src p) m)
    (hl : HolderLive s hd) :
    WF3 (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) ∧
      Inv3base (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  have hs := lt_of_getElem? hx
  have live := HolderLive.congr (addAuth_P s ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) rfl rfl
  have usable := fun q => S3.Usable.congr (q := q) (addAuth_P s ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) rfl rfl
  refine ⟨⟨hwf.frames, hwf.places, ⟨hwf.owners.1, hwf.owners.2.1, fun q hq => ?_⟩, ?_, ?_,
    rootChain_addAuth hwf.rootChain hx rfl hfp,
    hwf.rootHeld.transport rfl (fun r => (usable r).1)
      (fun i z hz _ _ => by rw [addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hz)]; exact hz), ?_⟩,
    addAuth_I1 i1 hx hal, ?_, fun q hq y hy => active_addAuth (i3 q ((usable q).1 hq) y hy),
    i4_always _⟩
  · obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hwf.owners.2.2 q ((usable q).1 hq)
    exact ⟨f, (FrameOf.congr (addAuth_P s _)).2 hf, hfF⟩
  · intro a y hy l hl'
    rcases addAuth_get hy with ⟨-, hy'⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact hwf.footprints a y hy' l hl'
    · exact hwf.footprints src x hx l (hfp l hl')
  · intro b y a hb ho
    rcases addAuth_get hb with ⟨-, hb''⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact hwf.origins b y a hb'' ho
    · cases ho; exact hs
  · intro a y hy ya
    rcases addAuth_get hy with ⟨-, hy'⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact (live _).2 (hwf.holders a y hy' ya)
    · exact (live _).2 hl
  · intro b y a hb ho
    rcases addAuth_get hb with ⟨-, hb''⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, h⟩ := i2 b y a hb'' ho
      exact ⟨x₁, by rw [addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hx₁)]; exact hx₁, h⟩
    · cases ho
      exact ⟨x, by rw [addAuth_lt hs]; exact hx, hm, hfp⟩

/-! ## Shape of `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Places after a transfer: owners within `src` move to the corresponding part of `dst` (§63,
`ok` effect). -/
theorem transfer_P_get (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P[q]? = (s.P[q]?).map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl := by
  simp [transferEff]

/-- Authorities after a transfer: holders within `src` move to the corresponding part of `dst`
(§63, `ok` effect). -/
theorem transfer_A_get (s : S3) (src dst j : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y := by
  simp [transferEff]

/-- A transfer keeps the number of places (§63). -/
theorem transfer_len (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P.length = s.P.length := by simp [transferEff]

/-- A transfer keeps the structural parents (§63). -/
theorem transfer_parentOf (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    parentOf (transferEff s src dst).P = parentOf s.P := by
  funext i; simp only [parentOf, transfer_P_get]
  cases s.P[i]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some pl => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A transfer keeps the footprints (§63). -/
theorem transfer_footprint (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    footprint (transferEff s src dst).P q = footprint s.P q :=
  footprint_congr (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst) q

/-- A transfer keeps the structural parts (§63). -/
theorem transfer_partOf (s : S3) (src dst r q : Nat) :
    partOf (transferEff s src dst).P r q ↔ partOf s.P r q := by
  simp only [partOf, transfer_parentOf, transfer_len]

/-- Membership in the children of a place (§63.2). -/
theorem mem_kids {P : List Place} {x r : Nat} :
    r ∈ kids P x ↔ r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = some x := by

/-! ## Preservation by `derive`, `split`, `release` (MM-03.3 §3, §10) -/

/-- `derive` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (MM-03.3 §3, O1; §10). The proof does not use O1.4. -/
theorem derive_preserves {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, -⟩, -, -, hfp, hal⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact addAuth_preserves hwf hinv hx (fun p hp => by simpa [S3.afp, hx] using hfp p hp) hal
    (top_mem hwf.ne)

/-- `derive_preserves_exclusivity` (MM-03.3 §10): `derive` preserves I1, under I1 alone. -/
theorem derive_preserves_exclusivity {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (h1 : I1 s)
    (h : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : I1 s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, -⟩, -, -, -, hal⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact addAuth_I1 h1 hx hal

theorem split_aux {src : Nat} {x : Authority} : ∀ (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3), WF3 s →
    Inv3base s → s.A[src]? = some x →
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify ∧ p ∈ x.footprint) →
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') →
    WF3 (splitEff s src rs) ∧ Inv3base (splitEff s src rs)
  | [], s, hwf, hinv, _, _, _ => by
    have : splitEff s src [] = s := by simp [splitEff]
    rw [this]; exact ⟨hwf, hinv⟩
  | r :: rs, s, hwf, hinv, hx, hr, hpw => by
    rw [splitEff_cons]
    have hs := lt_of_getElem? hx
    obtain ⟨hwf₁, hinv₁⟩ := addAuth_preserves (hd := .frame s.top) hwf hinv hx
      (fun p hp => (hr r (List.mem_cons_self ..) p hp).2)
      (fun p hp => by rw [(hr r (List.mem_cons_self ..) p hp).1]; simp [Allows, OptP, Mode.le])
      (top_mem hwf.ne)
    obtain ⟨hpr, hpw⟩ := List.pairwise_cons.1 hpw
    refine split_aux rs _ hwf₁ hinv₁ (by rw [addAuth_lt hs]; exact hx) (fun r' hr' p hp => ?_) hpw
    rw [effective_addAuth_notin hs fun h => hpr r' hr' p h hp]
    exact hr r' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr') p hp

/-- `split` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (MM-03.3 §3, O2; §10), under the obligation `DDSound k`
of `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem split_preserves_underDD {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {s s' : S3} {src : Nat}
    {rs : List (List Nat)} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s) (h : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) :
    WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, -⟩, -, h1, h2, h3, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine split_aux rs s hwf hinv hx (fun r hr p hp => ⟨h1 r hr p hp, ?_⟩)
    (h3.imp fun {r r'} h => h.elim id fun hd => hdd r r' hd)
  simpa [S3.afp, hx] using (h2 r hr p hp).1


/-- `release` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; §10). Under the strengthened I1 (A1),
releasing an authority only shrinks the set of active authorities. -/
theorem release_preserves {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, xa⟩, -, h3, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  have ha := lt_of_getElem? hx
  have e := releaseEff_eq hx
  have get : ∀ j, (releaseEff s a).A[j]? = if a = j then some { x with active := false }
      else s.A[j]? := fun j => by rw [e]; exact set_get ha
  have back : ∀ j z, (releaseEff s a).A[j]? = some z → ∃ z₀, s.A[j]? = some z₀ ∧
      z.mode = z₀.mode ∧ z.origin = z₀.origin ∧ z.footprint = z₀.footprint ∧
      z.holder = z₀.holder ∧ (z.active = true → z₀.active = true ∧ j ≠ a) := fun j z hz => by
    rw [get] at hz; split at hz
    · subst_vars; cases hz; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨z, hz, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, fun hz' => ⟨hz', Ne.symm ‹_›⟩⟩
  have hP : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (releaseEff s a).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (releaseEff s a).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  have hnF : (releaseEff s a).nF = s.nF := by rw [e]
  refine ⟨⟨fun b y o hb ho => ?_, fun b y hb l hl => ?_, hF ▸ hwf.ne, hF ▸ hwf.nodup,
    hF ▸ hnF ▸ hwf.frames, hP ▸ hnF ▸ hwf.ownerFrame, hP ▸ hwf.ownerPlace, hP ▸ hd ▸ hwf.parts,
    fun b y hb ya => ?_, hwf.rootChain.transport (by rw [hP]) (by rw [hP])
      (fun _ => by rw [release_ancs hx])
      (fun b y' hb => by obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, -, e', -⟩ := back b y' hb; exact ⟨y₀, hy₀, e'⟩)
      (fun x' z hz hzo => by
        by_cases e' : a = x'
        · subst e'; rw [hx] at hz; cases hz
          exact ⟨{ x with active := false }, by rw [get]; simp, hzo, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨z, by rw [get]; simp [e', hz], hzo, rfl⟩),
      hwf.rootHeld.transport hP fun x' z' hx' ho => by
        obtain ⟨z, hz, -, e1, e2, e3, -⟩ := back x' z' hx'
        exact ⟨z, hz, by rw [← e1]; exact ho, e2, e3⟩⟩,
    fun a' b' x' y' p hab ha' hb' xa' ya' xp yp hnab hnba => ?_,
    fun b y o hb ho => ?_, fun q hq y hy => ?_, i4_always _⟩
  · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, e', -⟩ := back b y hb; exact hwf.origin b y₀ o hy₀ (e' ▸ ho)
  · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, -, e', -⟩ := back b y hb; rw [hP]; exact hwf.fp b y₀ hy₀ l (e' ▸ hl)
  · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, -, -, eh, ea⟩ := back b y hb
    rw [eh, HolderLive.congr hP hF hd]; exact hwf.poss b y₀ hy₀ (ea ya).1
  · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, m₁, -, f₁, -, ac₁⟩ := back a' x' ha'
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, m₂, -, f₂, -, ac₂⟩ := back b' y' hb'
    rw [release_ancs hx] at hnab hnba; rw [m₁, m₂]
    exact i1 a' b' x₀ y₀ p hab hx₀ hy₀ (ac₁ xa').1 (ac₂ ya').1 (f₁ ▸ xp) (f₂ ▸ yp) hnab hnba
  · obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, m₀, e', f₀, -⟩ := back b y hb
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hh⟩ := i2 b y₀ o hy₀ (e' ▸ ho)
    refine ⟨if a = o then { x with active := false } else x₁, by rw [get]; split <;> simp_all,
      fun p hp => ?_⟩
    have := hh p (f₀ ▸ hp); rw [m₀]
    split
    · subst_vars; rw [hx] at hx₁; cases hx₁; exact this
    · exact this
  · have hq' := (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq
    obtain ⟨hy', hya⟩ := release_D_mem hx hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz, za⟩ := i3 q hq' y hy'
    refine ⟨z, ?_, za⟩
    rw [get]; split
    · subst_vars
      have := h3 q (List.mem_range.2 hq'.lt) hq' hy'
      rw [hx] at this; exact absurd (Option.some.inj this) (hya rfl)
    · exact hz

/-! ## States with the same authority skeleton -/

theorem SameSkel.i1 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h1 : I1 s) : I1 s' := by
  intro a b x' y' p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
  obtain ⟨x, hx, ex⟩ := h.get ha; obtain ⟨y, hy, ey⟩ := h.get hb
  simp [skel] at ex ey; rw [h.ancs] at hnab hnba
  rw [ex.1, ey.1]
  exact h1 a b x y p hab hx hy (ex.2.2.2 ▸ xa) (ey.2.2.2 ▸ ya) (ex.2.2.1 ▸ xp) (ey.2.2.1 ▸ yp)
    hnab hnba

/-- A local anchor, without origin, of a usable place has a frame, the place has a frame on the
stack, and the first is the second or one of its ancestors (B8, C1). -/
theorem AnchorOrder.frames {s : S3} (_hwf : WF3 s) (_h3 : I3 s) (ho : AnchorOrder s) {q x : Nat}
    (hq : s.Usable q) (hx : x ∈ s.D q) {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[x]? = some y)
    (hyo : y.origin = none) :
    ∃ g f, s.hframe y.holder = some g ∧ s.pframe q = some f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ ancestor s.F g f := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
  have hpf : s.pframe q = some f := pframe_iff.2 hf
  have he : s.effAnchor x = x :=
    effAnchor_eq (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) x (.inl rfl) (by simp [S3.org, hy, hyo])
  have hok := ho q hq x hx
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hok.frame (by rw [he]; exact hy)
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [he, hy, hpf] at hok; simp only [OptP] at hok; rw [hg] at hok; simp only at hok
  exact ⟨g, f, hg, hpf, hfF, hok⟩

theorem OnlyReleases.fwd {s s₁ : S3} (h : OnlyReleases s s₁) {x : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) :
    ∃ y', s₁.A[x]? = some y' ∧ y'.origin = y.origin ∧ y'.holder = y.holder := by
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ : ∃ y', s₁.A[x]? = some y' :=
    ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨by rw [h.1]; exact lt_of_getElem? hy, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, e1, -, e2, -⟩ := h.2 x y' hy'
  rw [hy] at hy₀; cases hy₀
  exact ⟨y', hy', e1, e2⟩

theorem release_releases (s : S3) (a : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (releaseEff s a) := by
  unfold releaseEff
  split
  · rename_i x hx
    refine ⟨by simp, fun j z hz => ?_⟩
    rw [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx)] at hz
    split at hz
    · subst_vars; cases hz; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨z, hz, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, id⟩
  · exact ⟨rfl, fun j z hz => ⟨z, hz, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, id⟩⟩

/-- `derive` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §3, O1), under `AnchorOrder` alone. -/
theorem derive_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hao.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ _ _ hx => hx)
    (fun _ ha => ancs_addAuth_lt ha)
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by rw [deriveEff, addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy, rfl, rfl⟩)

/-- `split` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §3, O2), under `AnchorOrder` alone. -/
theorem split_preserves_anchorOrder {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (hao : AnchorOrder s) (h : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hao.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ _ _ hx => hx)
    (fun a ha => chain_congr fun j hj => by
      simp only [S3.org]; show ((s.A ++ _)[j]?).bind _ = _
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)])
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by
      show (s.A ++ _)[x]? = _; rw [List.getElem?_append_left (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy,
      rfl, rfl⟩)

/-- `release` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §3, O3), under `AnchorOrder` alone. -/
theorem release_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hr := release_releases s a
  have hP : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hF : (releaseEff s a).F = s.F := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hd : (releaseEff s a).dead = s.dead := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hD : ∀ q, ∀ x ∈ (releaseEff s a).D q, x ∈ s.D q := fun q x hx => by
    cases hy : s.A[a]? with
    | none => unfold releaseEff at hx; rw [hy] at hx; exact hx
    | some y => exact (release_D_mem hy hx).1
  exact hao.of hP hF (fun q hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq)
    (fun q _ x hx => hD q x hx) (fun _ _ => by unfold S3.ancs; rw [hr.org])
---
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (z : Authority), s'.A[j]? = some z → z.active = true → ∀ l ∈ z.footprint,
      ∃ (i : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[i]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ l ∈ y.footprint) :
    NoDangling s' := by
  intro j z hz za q hq l hl hlz
  obtain ⟨i, y, hy, ya, hly⟩ := hA j z hz za l hlz
  exact hnd i y hy ya q (fun h => hq (hu q h)) l (hfp q l hl) hly

/-- `derive` preserves `NoDangling` (C2; MM-03.3 §3, O1): the derived footprint is within the
footprint of the active origin. -/
theorem derive_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, xa⟩, -, -, hsub, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine hnd.of (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ h => h.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) fun j z hz za => ?_
  rcases addAuth_get hz with ⟨-, hy⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
  · exact fun l hl => ⟨j, z, hy, za, hl⟩
  · exact fun l hl => ⟨src, x, hx, xa, by have := hsub l hl; simp only [S3.afp, hx] at this; exact this⟩

/-- `split` preserves `NoDangling` (C2; MM-03.3 §3, O2): each region is within the footprint of
the active origin. -/
theorem split_preserves_noDangling {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (hnd : NoDangling s) (h : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, xa⟩, -, -, hreg, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine hnd.of (fun _ _ h => h) (fun _ h => h.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) fun j z hz za => ?_
  simp only [splitEff] at hz
  by_cases hj : j < s.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at hz; exact fun l hl => ⟨j, z, hz, za, hl⟩
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), List.getElem?_map] at hz
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hz
    intro l hl
    have := (hreg r (List.mem_of_getElem? hr) l hl).1; simp only [S3.afp, hx] at this
    exact ⟨src, x, hx, xa, this⟩

/-- `release` preserves `NoDangling` (C2; MM-03.3 §3, O3): it activates nothing. -/
theorem release_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (hnd : NoDangling s)
    (h : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : NoDangling s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hP : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hF : (releaseEff s a).F = s.F := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hd : (releaseEff s a).dead = s.dead := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  refine hnd.of (fun _ _ h => by rw [hP] at h; exact h)
    (fun _ h => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 h) fun j z hz za => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, e, -, ea⟩ := (release_releases s a).2 j z hz
  exact fun l hl => ⟨j, y, hy, ea za, e ▸ hl⟩

/-- `depend` preserves `NoDangling` (C2; MM-03.3 §3, O5): it changes no authority. -/
theorem depend_preserves_noDangling {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hnd : NoDangling s)
---
  have hok := ho q (hu q hq) x y hy ya₀ hh₀
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hok.get
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := effAnchor_congr (hanc x hok.lt)
  obtain ⟨z', hz', -, e2⟩ := hA _ z hz
  exact (effAnchorOK_of_same hz (by rw [he]; exact hz') (by rw [e2, S3.hframe_congr hP])
    (fun g f _ => by rw [hF]) (S3.pframe_congr hP q)).2 hok

/-- An active authority held by a place after releases was active and held by it before. -/
theorem OnlyReleases.back {s s₁ : S3} (h : OnlyReleases s s₁) {x q : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hx : s₁.A[x]? = some y') (ya : y'.active = true) (hh : y'.holder = .place q) :
    ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .place q := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, -, e, ha⟩ := h.2 x y' hx
  exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya, e ▸ hh⟩

/-- `derive` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; MM-03.3 §3, O1): the new authority is held by the
frame; the others keep holders and chains. -/
theorem derive_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode}
    (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hs : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  refine h.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ ha => ancs_addAuth_lt ha)
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by rw [deriveEff, addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy, rfl, rfl⟩)
    fun x q y' hx ya hh => ?_
  rcases addAuth_get hx with ⟨-, hx'⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨y', hx', ya, hh⟩
  · cases hh

/-- `split` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; MM-03.3 §3, O2): the new authorities are held by the
frame. -/
theorem split_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hs : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  refine h.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl)
    (fun a ha => chain_congr fun j hj => by
      simp only [S3.org]; show ((s.A ++ _)[j]?).bind _ = _
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)])
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by
      show (s.A ++ _)[x]? = _; rw [List.getElem?_append_left (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy,
      rfl, rfl⟩)
    fun x q y' hx ya hh => ?_
  have hx' : (s.A ++ rs.map fun r => (⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ : Authority))[x]? =
    some y' := hx
  by_cases hxl : x < s.A.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hxl] at hx'; exact ⟨y', hx', ya, hh⟩
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega), List.getElem?_map] at hx'
    cases hr : rs[x - s.A.length]? with
    | none => rw [hr] at hx'; cases hx'
    | some r => rw [hr] at hx'; cases hx'; cases hh

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` carries over when authorities are only released and places, stack and
usability do not grow (G4). -/
theorem releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld {s s₁ : S3} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hr : OnlyReleases s s₁) (hP : s₁.P = s.P) (hF : s₁.F = s.F)
    (hu : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → s.Usable q) : AnchorOrderHeld s₁ :=
  h.of hP hF hu (fun _ _ => by unfold S3.ancs; rw [hr.org]) (fun _ _ hy => hr.fwd hy)
    fun _ _ _ hx ya hh => hr.back hx ya hh

/-- `release` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
theorem release_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hs : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  have hP : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hF : (releaseEff s a).F = s.F := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hd : (releaseEff s a).dead = s.dead := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  exact releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld h (release_releases s a) hP hF
    fun _ hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` carries over when authorities, places, stack and `dead` flags are unchanged
(G4): `depend`, `write3`, `writeShared`, `pin`, `unpin`, `newArena`, `reset`. -/
theorem sameA_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s s' : S3} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hA : s'.A = s.A)
    (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : AnchorOrderHeld s' :=
  h.of hP hF (fun _ hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq)
    (fun _ _ => by unfold S3.ancs S3.org; rw [hA]) (fun _ y hy => ⟨y, by rw [hA]; exact hy, rfl, rfl⟩)
    fun _ _ y' hx ya hh => ⟨y', by rw [← hA]; exact hx, ya, hh⟩

/-- `endUse` preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (G4; A6). -/
theorem endUse_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s)
    (hs : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  exact releases_preserve_anchorOrderHeld h ((endUseS_releases s p).trans cleanup_releases) rfl rfl
    fun q hq => S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := endUseEff s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
      (fun q h => by simp only [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) hq

def cleanup (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A.map fun y => if HolderLive s y.holder then y else { y with active := false } }

/-- The authorities of `s₁` are those of `s`, some of them released. -/
def OnlyReleases (s s₁ : S3) : Prop :=
  s₁.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ (j : Nat) (z : Authority), s₁.A[j]? = some z →
    ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ z.mode = y.mode ∧ z.origin = y.origin ∧ z.footprint = y.footprint ∧
      z.holder = y.holder ∧ (z.active = true → y.active = true)

theorem OnlyReleases.org {s s₁ : S3} (h : OnlyReleases s s₁) : s₁.org = s.org := by
  funext j; simp only [S3.org]
  cases hz : s₁.A[j]? with
  | none =>
    have : s.A.length ≤ j := by have := List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.1 hz; rw [h.1] at this; exact this
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 this]
  | some z => obtain ⟨y, hy, -, ho, -⟩ := h.2 j z hz; simp [hy, ho]

theorem cleanup_get (s : S3) (j : Nat) : (cleanup s).A[j]? =
    (s.A[j]?).map fun y => if HolderLive s y.holder then y else { y with active := false } := by
  simp [cleanup]

theorem cleanup_releases {s : S3} : OnlyReleases s (cleanup s) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [cleanup], fun j z hz => ?_⟩
  rw [cleanup_get] at hz
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz; cases hz
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hz; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hz; subst hz
    refine ⟨y, rfl, ?_⟩; split <;> simp_all

theorem OnlyReleases.trans {s s₁ s₂ : S3} (h₁ : OnlyReleases s s₁) (h₂ : OnlyReleases s₁ s₂) :
    OnlyReleases s s₂ := by
  refine ⟨h₂.1.trans h₁.1, fun j z hz => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁, m₁, o₁, f₁, h₁', a₁⟩ := h₂.2 j z hz
  obtain ⟨y, hy, m, o, f, hh, a⟩ := h₁.2 j y₁ hy₁
  exact ⟨y, hy, m₁.trans m, o₁.trans o, f₁.trans f, h₁'.trans hh, fun h => a (a₁ h)⟩

theorem OnlyReleases.rootChain {s s₁ : S3} (h : OnlyReleases s s₁) (hc : RootChain s)
    (hP : s₁.P = s.P) : RootChain s₁ :=
  hc.transport (by rw [hP]) (by rw [hP]) (fun a => by unfold S3.ancs; rw [h.org])
    (fun a y' ha => by obtain ⟨y, hy, -, -, e, -⟩ := h.2 a y' ha; exact ⟨y, hy, e⟩)
    (fun x z hz hzo => by
      obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ : ∃ z', s₁.A[x]? = some z' :=
        ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨by rw [h.1]; exact lt_of_getElem? hz, rfl⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀, -, e1, e2, -⟩ := h.2 x z' hz'
      rw [hz] at hz₀; cases hz₀
      exact ⟨z', hz', e1.trans hzo, e2⟩)

theorem OnlyReleases.rootHeld {s s₁ : S3} (h : OnlyReleases s s₁) (hr : RootHeld s)
    (hP : s₁.P = s.P) : RootHeld s₁ :=
  hr.transport hP fun x z' hx ho => by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, -, e1, e2, e3, -⟩ := h.2 x z' hx
    exact ⟨z, hz, e1 ▸ ho, e2, e3⟩

/-- `Inv3base` part of `releases_preserve`, without `WF3` (A1): releasing authorities and then those
whose holder died preserves `Inv3base`, provided no usable place keeps an anchor that is
released. -/
theorem releases_preserve_inv3 {s s₁ : S3} (hinv : Inv3base s) (hr : OnlyReleases s s₁)
    (hI3 : ∀ q, s₁.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s₁.D q, (cleanup s₁).Active x) : Inv3base (cleanup s₁) := by
  have hc := hr.trans cleanup_releases
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, -, -⟩ := hinv
